boundary: This ledger records evidence-backed issue/PR disposition status and captured runner/job check outcomes only. It does not fabricate proof execution, does not confer publication authority, and does not close issues or merge PRs. Any 'remaining_condition' describes unmet gating evidenced by repository control records or explicit issue text.
limitations: For evidence-only PRs (#182, #190), only GitHub check-run conclusion metadata was captured in this ledger. No artifacts were downloaded and no log-level inference was performed beyond the check conclusion.

For merged implementation PRs (#170, #174, #178), issue closure is recorded as GitHub state only. Where repository control records still mark proof execution as pending, this ledger reflects the mismatch as a 'remaining_condition' rather than an acceptance claim.
No scanning was performed over untrusted or overlapping D1 contract artifacts during this ledger build beyond avoiding direct interaction with the specified D1 file set.
